title: Nvidia hardware worth $11.4M vanished between Oakland and Texas
summary: 6 pallets of hardware vanished en route to Texas, with no arrests 2 months later.
llm_summary: A shipment of six pallets containing Nvidia equipment—valued at about $11.4 million—disappeared while being transported from Oakland, California, to a facility in Texas. The loss was reported two months ago, and despite an ongoing investigation, no suspects have been identified or arrested
